name: Exethanter's Notes
summary: Exethanter, the last Warden of the Amber Temple, has forgotten what he was doing this morning. His notes have come unpinned.

stages.journal: Exethanter has forgotten what he was doing this morning. Five of the notes pinned to him have come loose, out of order, and he can't tell which goes where.
objectives: Put Exethanter's loose notes in order
stages.hint: Talk to Exethanter in the Amber Temple and ask about his notes.

stages.journal: Put in order, the notes said what he was doing this morning: making tea. Exethanter made us a cup.
